issue_context.title: Svelte 5: hydration doesn't repair changing attributes from server to client (even in legacy mode)
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug Something like this ```svelte
div
``` should output ```html
div
``` after hydration (at least in legacy mode) but it doesn't because the attribute is inlined and the div is not marked as dynamic. ### Reproduction [repl](https://www.sveltelab.dev/z9lnat07mfofxcw) 1. open the main page 2. check the html ### Logs _No response_ ### System Info ```shell System: OS: Linux 5.0 undefined CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz Memory: 0 Bytes / 0 Bytes Shell: 1.0 - /bin/jsh Binaries: Node: 18.20.3 - /usr/local/bin/node Yarn: 1.22.19 - /usr/local/bin/yarn npm: 10.2.3 - /usr/local/bin/npm pnpm: 8.15.6 - /usr/local/bin/pnpm npmPackages: svelte: ^5.2.3 => 5.2.3 ``` ### Severity annoyance
comments: This feels adjacent to #13517 / #14272. IMO we shouldn't try to handle this, and we should document this as a breaking change.
